verdict.rationale: Sprinto documents background automation in several forms: continuous monitoring with automated evidence collection and alerts, AI risk auto-scoring, and user-built ingestion workflows (which its AI Editor can create from natural-language prompts) that webhooks trigger to process external events autonomously. The compliance-skills package also fires PII checks 'without being asked'. However, user-configurable automation appears limited to ingestion workflows and pre-mapped compliance checks, and the docs give little detail on how these automations run unattended. Missing for 10: documented scheduling or trigger options beyond webhooks, general-purpose user-defined automation beyond ingestion, autonomous remediation actions, independent or hands-on corroboration.
